positions.title: Machine Learning Research Intern
positions.description: Assessed the usefulness of noisily labeled data in training convolutional neural networks. Implemented statistical supervised learning models for using Torch/PyTorch/TensorFlow. Presented analysis on a variety of deep learning architectures and preprocessing techniques. Supervised by Professor Fei Sha.

positions.title: CSCI 270 (Algorithms) Course Producer
positions.description: Course title: Introduction to Algorithms and the Theory of Computing. Taught students algorithm design techniques (dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, divide and conquer, etc.), runtime analysis, computability theory. Held office hours weekly to supervise groups of 10-15 students. Led review sessions for groups of 40-50 students to reinforce course concepts.
